stemMd: At what time is R predicted to reach30degrees C, using the stated linear trend?
explanationMd: R reaches28degrees at60s and32degrees at90s. Thirty degrees is halfway, so the interpolated time is75s.

distractorRationale.b: Thirty degrees lies before the90s reading, not after it.
